senses.gloss: (cmp. ענף) to intertwine, fasten by means of a loop, contrad. to קָשַׁר.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 113a:4">Sabb. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>לא יהא קושרו אלא עוֹנְבוֹ</he> he must not knot (the broken rope) but loop it; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:16">Tosef. ib. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:16">XIII</cite>), 16 <he>עוֹנְבִין אותו</he>. Sabb. l. c. <he>ובלבד שלא יַעַנְבֶנּוּ</he> provided he does not fasten it with a loop. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 19; Y. ib. X, 26ᶜ bot. <he>משלשל מלמעלן ועוֹנֵב וכ׳</he> he pulls the cord down and makes the loop at the bottom; Bab. ib. 102ᵇ <he>עוֹנְבָהּ</he>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>עָנוּב</he>; f. <cite ref="P00776"><he>עֲנוּבָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>עֲנוּבִים</he> &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:6">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 6</cite> <he>קשור וע׳</he> if the handle is tied to the vessel with a knot or loop. Mekh. Yithro, Baḥod., s. 3 <he>הרי אתם קשורים ע׳ תפוסים</he> you are now tied, looped, held fast (by the covenant); a. e.
